features.title: Platform Foundation and Environments
features.user_visible_behavior: A developer can open ProjectBrain locally, see a healthy API response, and see a clear unavailable state when MongoDB or a required provider configuration is missing.
verification: Run `./init.sh`.
Run `pnpm install`.
Run `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build`.
Start the app and call `/api/health` and `/api/ready`.
Unset `MONGODB_URI` and confirm `/api/ready` returns 503 naming it.
Confirm `.env*` files are git-ignored and no client bundle references a provider key.
features.evidence: 2026-09-26 (Atlas): pnpm db:setup ok; next build ok; next start -> GET /api/health 200 {ok:true}; GET /api/ready 200 {ok:true,mongodb:"reachable"}; with MONGODB_URI unset GET /api/ready 503 {ok:false,reason:"missing_config",missing:["MONGODB_URI"]}; .env.development.local git-ignored; .next/static has no MONGODB_URI or provider keys (only sk- hit is React "mask-type").

features.title: Memory Collections and Search Indexes
features.user_visible_behavior: Project memory for one project can be stored and retrieved as messages, decisions, attempts, entities, edges, warnings, feedback, and harness versions. Search results from another project do not appear.
verification: Run `pnpm db:setup` against the development cluster.
Insert one attempt, one decision, and one edge for project `orbit`, then read them back by project id.
Run a `$vectorSearch` with a fixture embedding filtered to `orbit` and `outcome in [failed, abandoned]`.
Insert an attempt for a second project and confirm it is excluded.
Run `pnpm db:setup` a second time and confirm no errors.
features.evidence: 2026-09-26 (Atlas): pnpm db:setup created 12 collections and search indexes attempts_vector, decisions_vector, memory_text, all READY; inserted orbit attempt/decision/edge and read back by projectId {attempt:1,decision:1,edge:1}; $vectorSearch attempts_vector filter {projectId:orbit,outcome in [failed,abandoned]} returned only verify-orbit-att (score 1), identical-vector attempt for project other excluded; second pnpm db:setup reported all indexes exist (READY), no errors; test rows removed.

features.title: Harness Config v1
features.user_visible_behavior: The active harness version for a project can be read, and it supplies the extraction prompts, match prompts, `k`, `minScore`, hybrid weight, and model routing.
verification: Run the harness unit test.
Load fixtures and read the active harness for `orbit`.
Confirm there is exactly one active version.
features.evidence: 2026-09-26 (Atlas): vitest harness test passed (14/14 total); pnpm db:fixtures -> orbit: harness v1 active; getActiveHarness(orbit) from Atlas -> harness-orbit-v1 version 1, retrieval {k:8,minScore:0.72,hybridWeight:0.3}, routing classify/extract openai/gpt-5-mini, judge/reflect anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5; countDocuments({projectId:orbit,active:true}) = 1; inserting a second active version rejected with E11000 on one_active.

features.title: Shared Types, Contracts, and Orbit Fixture
features.user_visible_behavior: Either lane can run the app against a realistic Orbit fixture before the other lane's code exists.
verification: Run `pnpm typecheck`.
Run `pnpm test` (fixture shape and contract tests).
Run `pnpm db:fixtures` when `MONGODB_URI` is set.
features.evidence: 2026-09-26: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit exit 0; pnpm exec vitest run -> 14/14 passed (fixture R31/R32 shape, contract placeholders, socket.io plan matches att-websockets with 14h, App Runner reopens WebSockets); next build succeeded.

features.title: App Shell and Design Tokens
features.user_visible_behavior: Every screen shares the lab-notebook shell: paper background, beige index navigation, red margin line, and the red, amber, and green status marks.
verification: Run `pnpm build`.
Open each route in a browser and confirm the shell and nav render.
Compare against `design/01-timeline.png`.

features.title: Message Classification
features.user_visible_behavior: Each captured message is stored and labeled `decision`, `attempt_start`, `attempt_result`, `intent`, `question`, or `noise`.
verification: Run the classifier unit tests.
Classify 20 labeled Orbit messages and record accuracy.

features.title: Attempt and Decision Extraction
features.user_visible_behavior: A message that reports a failure becomes an attempt with goal, approach, outcome, blockers, evidence, conditions, and hours. A decision message becomes a decision.
verification: Run the extraction schema tests.
Extract the Postgres LIKE result and verify blockers, evidence, and 9 hours.
Extract the sessions, JWT, and Better Auth decisions and verify the supersede chain.

features.title: Attempt Merging and the Ingest Pipeline
features.user_visible_behavior: A captured Slack-style or web message becomes a structured decision or attempt. A later result in the same thread updates that attempt instead of creating a duplicate.
verification: Post a start then a result in one thread and verify one attempt with outcome, blockers, and evidence.
Verify noise is stored and creates nothing.
Verify embeddings exist on new records.
Verify each step wrote a trace.

features.title: Manual Web Capture
features.user_visible_behavior: On `/capture`, a member types or pastes a message, picks a thread or starts one, and sees what ProjectBrain extracted from it.
verification: Capture the WebSockets start and result in the browser and see one attempt.
Capture a noise message and see the noise label with no record.
Check loading and error states.

features.title: Orbit Seed Through the Pipeline
features.user_visible_behavior: The Orbit project shows six weeks of history, including four dead ends, a superseded auth chain, and a later decision that can reopen the WebSockets dead end.
verification: Run the seed on an empty database.
Confirm the four dead ends and their hours.
Confirm the supersede chain.
Diff seeded records against `fixtures/orbit.json`.

features.title: Slack Event Capture
features.user_visible_behavior: A message posted in a connected Slack channel is stored and processed once.
verification: Run the signature tests.
Replay the socket.io fixture event twice and confirm one stored message.
Send a bad signature and confirm 401.

features.title: Revisitable Conditions
features.user_visible_behavior: When a new decision satisfies a dead end's conditions, ProjectBrain marks that attempt revisitable and says which blocker may no longer apply.
verification: Capture the App Runner decision.
Verify the WebSockets status and explanation.
Verify an unrelated decision changes nothing.
Verify the `unblocks` edge.
Replay and verify one transition.

features.title: Evidence Storage
features.user_visible_behavior: Evidence files such as logs and benchmarks can be opened from a dead-end record.
verification: Upload a fixture log and open it from the WebSockets attempt.
Confirm the URL expires.

features.title: AWS Hosting and Worker
features.user_visible_behavior: ProjectBrain runs on AWS, and captures are processed by a background worker.
verification: Validate the infrastructure definition.
Run the worker entrypoint on a fixture capture job.
Invoke the schedule hook the way the schedule would.

features.title: Dead-End Check
features.user_visible_behavior: Pasting a plan that repeats a failed approach returns the matching dead end, blocker, evidence, alternative, hours, and confidence. A different idea does not warn.
verification: Run retrieval and judge tests, including tricky non-matches.
POST the socket.io plan and verify a match above the cutoff.
POST an unrelated plan and verify no warning.
Verify the judge can reject a high vector score.
Verify project isolation.

features.title: Check an Idea
features.user_visible_behavior: On `/check`, a pasted plan shows similar dead ends with confidence, evidence, alternative, and hours, or an explicit no-match state.
verification: Paste the socket.io plan in the browser.
Paste a new idea and see no match.
Mark a result not relevant and read the feedback back.
Check loading and error states.

features.title: Ask the Brain
features.user_visible_behavior: On `/ask`, a question returns a concise answer with cited attempt and decision cards.
verification: Ask the Postgres question and open a citation.
Ask about auth and verify current and superseded.
Ask something unsupported.
Verify citations resolve in the same project.

features.title: Timeline and Dead-End Detail
features.user_visible_behavior: The Orbit timeline shows six weeks of decisions and attempts. Failed attempts are red, revisitable ones amber, and a dead end opens to goal, approach, blockers, evidence, conditions, hours, and the alternative.
verification: Load Orbit and verify order and colors.
Open WebSockets and verify evidence, 14 hours, conditions, and SSE.
After `f-a-07`, verify it turns amber in the browser.

features.title: Slack Proactive Warning
features.user_visible_behavior: When someone says in Slack they are about to repeat a failed approach, ProjectBrain replies in that thread with the dead end, evidence, alternative, and hours saved.
verification: Run the handler against the socket.io fixture with a mocked Slack client.
Verify a non-match posts nothing.
Verify the warning record.
Click Not relevant and verify feedback.

features.title: Eval Set and Runner
features.user_visible_behavior: Running the eval reports dead-end precision and recall, citation accuracy, staleness, and hours saved for the active harness.
verification: Validate the case counts.
Run `pnpm eval` on v1 and record the scores.

features.title: Reflection and Promotion
features.user_visible_behavior: Running reflection proposes one harness change, reruns the evals, and keeps it only when the score improves without a precision drop. Rejections are recorded with the reason.
verification: Force a precision-lowering candidate and verify rejection.
Run an improving candidate and verify promotion.
Verify feedback is an input.

features.title: Harness Lab and Impact
features.user_visible_behavior: Harness Lab shows versions, scores, and diffs, and can run reflection. Impact shows warnings sent, hours saved, and the precision trend.
verification: Open Lab and verify two versions and a diff.
Run reflection from the button.
Open Impact and check the hours-saved sum.

features.title: Memory Graph
features.user_visible_behavior: A graph shows decisions, attempts, and entities connected by caused-by, superseded-by, alternative-to, blocked-by, and unblocks edges.
verification: Render Orbit and verify the chains.
Select a node.
Verify the `unblocks` edge after `f-a-07`.
